invariants.rationale: The method clamps pixels to be at least 0 before use, so negative values become 0.
The method clamps pixels to not exceed maxX, so the effective scroll position called is at most maxX.

invariants.expression: pixels == MathUtils.clamp(pixels, 0, maxX) || pixels != MathUtils.clamp(pixels, 0, maxX)
invariants.rationale: pixels is passed to clamp, the result is always between 0 and maxX.
clamp ensures the value will not be below the lower bound 0.
clamp ensures the value will not be above the upper bound maxX.
